title: Fund transfer error and amount deducted twice
body:
There is an issue in fund transfer for this app. It won't allow you to track the transfer done. Moreover there is no transaction log of transfer. 

This is what happened to me... I did a money transfer via snap app. Even after 4 to 5 days the transfer didn't happen and there was no transaction log. Called customer care and they said the request is in progress. After one week called again and escalated. They told the transfer is rejected and to re-initiate the transfer. Second time I did transfer via normal Mashreq website and it happened successfully. After 10 days I found that the transfer done via snap got processed again and money got deducted from my account twice. Called customer care and they said they can't do anything about that and they will take a feedback about this !!!! 
Customer got money deducted twice and bank telling they will just take a feedback ???? That's not acceptable at all. 
Never rely on fund transfer via snap app. Always do via Mashreq online.
